```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
url = "https://byui-cse.github.io/cse110-course/lesson11/life-expectancy.csv"

df = pl.read_csv(url)
df.columns = ["Entity", "Code", "Year", "Life_yrs"]
```




```{python}
usa = df.filter(pl.col("Entity") == "United States")
```


Create a line chart of USA life expectancies over time.

```{python}
(
  ggplot(data=usa, mapping=aes(x="Year", y="Life_yrs"))
  + geom_line()
  + geom_rect(xmin=1915, xmax=1920, ymin=45, ymax=55, fill="red", alpha=.2, color="blue")
  + geom_vline(xintercept=1943, color="red", size=1.2, linetype=2)
  + geom_text(x=1945, y=62, label="Last decrease", hjust=1, angle=90)
)
```


Graphing multiple countries
```{python}
three = df.filter(pl.col("Entity").is_in(["United States", "Japan", "France"]))
```



```{python}
(
  ggplot(data=three, mapping=aes(x="Year", y="Life_yrs", color="Entity"))
  + geom_line()
  + labs(title="Millions Die in Spanish Flu", subtitle="Except in Japan", y="Life expectancy")
)
```
